title: "The Food Noise Disappeared — and So Did 47 Pounds"
excerpt: Sarah M. spent 30 years battling her weight. After 8 months on Wegovy, the constant mental chatter about food went quiet for the first time. Here's her full journey — the breakthrough, the side effects, and what she wishes she'd known from day one.

title: "Ozempic Made Me Miserable. Mounjaro Changed Everything."
excerpt: James R. almost gave up on GLP-1 medications entirely after severe nausea on Ozempic. His doctor suggested switching to Mounjaro — and the difference was night and day.

title: "I Wish Someone Had Warned Me About the Protein Problem"
excerpt: Priya K. lost 32 lbs on Zepbound in 4 months — but a DEXA scan revealed she'd lost almost as much muscle as fat. Her hard-won advice on eating enough when you have zero appetite.

title: "Trulicity Gave Me My A1C Back — and My Confidence"
excerpt: David T. was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes at 42 and felt like a failure. After 18 months on Trulicity, his A1C dropped from 9.1 to 6.4 — and he stopped dreading blood work.

title: "2 Years on Saxenda: The Honest Truth About What Happens Long-Term"
excerpt: Maria L. has been on Saxenda for over two years. She shares what nobody talks about — the plateaus, the social pressure, the insurance battles, and why she's staying on it anyway.

title: "Nobody Prepared Me for the Emotional Side of Rapid Weight Loss"
excerpt: Tom W. lost 60 lbs in 7 months on Wegovy. Physically, he felt great. Mentally, he was struggling with identity, loose skin anxiety, and a complicated relationship with his "before" self.

title: "Ozempic Didn't Just Help My Weight — It Helped My PCOS"
excerpt: Rachel S. started Ozempic for weight management but was stunned when her PCOS symptoms dramatically improved. Her periods became regular for the first time in a decade.

title: "My Wife and I Both Started Mounjaro. Here's What Happened."
excerpt: Carlos and Elena D. started Mounjaro together. He lost 45 lbs in 5 months; she lost 18. Their story about different responses, supporting each other, and navigating it as a couple.

title: "I Stopped Ozempic After 14 Months. Here's What Happened Next."
excerpt: Nina P. decided to stop Ozempic after reaching her goal weight. She shares the honest reality of weight regain, what she kept, and what she'd do differently.
